entries.title: Psalms 82:1
segments:
A psalm in which unjust rulers and judges are rebuked, and their duties set forth. 
 
  The gods; rulers; called gods on account of their having received from God authority to act as his representatives and in his behalf.

Although rulers are elevated to a resemblance in authority and power to the Most High, yet they are dependent upon God for their influence, and to him must render an account for the manner in which they employ it.

entries.title: Psalms 82:2
segments: Accept the persons; be guilty of partiality and injustice.

entries.title: Psalms 82:4
segments: One great object of civil government is to defend the poor, weak, and defenceless against the encroachments of the rich and the strong, and to award equal justice to all.

entries.title: Psalms 82:5
segments:
Walk on in darkness; continue to pervert justice in their administration. 
 
  Out of course; society is disorganized by their ignorance and iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 82:6
segments: Ye are gods; the representatives of God.  See note to

entries.title: Psalms 82:7
segments:
Like men; like other men, they must die and give an account of their stewardship. 
 
It becomes rulers as well as ruled to keep in view their sins, and act with an habitual reference to the time when all will stand on a level before God, and receive a retribution according to their works.
